description: This file defines the CalendarAccountValidationService class, which provides validation methods for CalendarAccount objects within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for validating personal account limits, group account creation permissions, and duplicate external calendars.

classes.name: CalendarAccountValidationService
classes.description: A service class that performs various validation checks on CalendarAccount objects to ensure business rules and constraints are satisfied.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a CalendarAccount and User object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs all validation steps and returns true if all validations pass.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns an array of validation error messages.

methods.name: getFirstError
methods.description: Returns the first error message, or null if there are no errors.

methods.name: validatePersonalAccountLimit
methods.description: Validates that a user does not exceed the personal calendar account limit.

methods.name: validateGroupAccountCreation
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to create a group calendar account.

methods.name: validateDuplicateExternalCalendar
methods.description: Checks for duplicate external calendar IDs to prevent duplication.
